title: Influence modulus from noise modulus
statement: Let $\varepsilon:[0,1/2]\to[0,1]$ and let $n$ be a nonnegative integer. If $n\ge2$, define the resulting parameter to be $\min\!\left(1,\frac{2}{1-e^{-2}}\varepsilon(1/n)\right)$; if $n<2$, define it to be $1$.
